name: io.github.thebriangao/totem
description: Your own WHOOP server for AI apps: recovery, sleep, strain, workouts, journal and more (41 tools).

environmentVariables.name: TOTEM_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the WHOOP login is kept. Default: ~/.config/totem/tokens.json, written by `npx @thebriangao/totem auth --local`.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/Los_Angeles) for times in answers. Default: the timezone in your WHOOP profile.
